title: Vinyume vya Vihusishi (Theme 10: Kukabiliana na msongo wa mawazo)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 9 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child gives the relating word of the opposite meaning (juu ya / chini ya, kabla ya / baada ya) and uses it in a passage.

floor.prerequisite: Uses relating words of place and time.
floor.question: Jaza: Paka yuko ___ ya kitanda.

contexts: coping with stress: kabla ya mtihani / baada ya mtihani

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child writes "nyuma ya" and two more pairs.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Kinyume cha juu ya ni kipi?" Kwa nini "mbele ya" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Kinyume cha juu ya ni chini ya.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Kinyume cha ndani ya ni kipi?" Kwa nini "juu ya" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Kinyume cha ndani ya ni nje ya.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Kinyume cha kabla ya ni kipi?" Kwa nini "wakati wa" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Kinyume cha kabla ya ni baada ya.
Kinyume cha kihusishi ni kihusishi kingine: nje ya.
